Deliberately excluded as irrelevant to this choice: **Archive Lantern Condition: repaired** and the circumstances of its damage, because they do not determine how testimony can safely re-enter public memory. I also exclude new revelations, new custodians, and changes to the treaty because none are established or required.

This is a non-authoritative recommendation; it creates no canon, Book Direction, or Canonical State.
